purpose: Primary curriculum taxonomy for the SCE Nephrology learning system. Derived from the 10 KSAP categories currently embedded in SCE.html. StudyPRN topics are a supplementary crosswalk, not the primary hierarchy.

source.copyright_note: Contains taxonomy labels and derived identifiers only; no proprietary question stems or answer content.

identifier_convention.cross_cutting: A concept has one primary main_topic_id. Use related_topic_ids only for secondary links.

selection_policy.studyprn_handling: Map notes, errors, and study activity to the most specific KSAP main topic and subtopic. Preserve the original StudyPRN label as source metadata only.
selection_policy.ckd_rule: Do not create separate top-level HD, PD, CKD-MBD, or renal-anaemia categories; classify them beneath Chronic Kidney Disease.
selection_policy.cross_cutting_rule: Where a concept is relevant to several areas, record one primary KSAP main topic and optional related_topic_ids; do not duplicate the concept.
